note: Go Camp Tennessee campground on Normandy Lake (TVA land) near Manchester, across the lake from Barton Springs, with a swimming beach, a boat ramp and a pavilion. The lakefront sites line the shore side of the loop by the beach. --Claude
summary: Cedar Point: operator page (headless; curl 403) and Campspot confirm 53 sites (45 water/electric to 50 A, 8 primitive), store, season Mar 15-Nov 15, 2-night minimum (Apr 2027 too). Lakefront KEPT on Campspot's 10 waterfront sites (05-21 odd, 22) along the beach-side shore. No operator change. max_rig set 43.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront KEPT: Campspot's 'Waterfront Water & Electric RV Site' type names 05, 07, 09, 11, 13, 15, 17, 19, 21, 22, sold by the night (2-night minimum); the Campspot map draws them along the shore beside the swim beach. On Esri imagery (winter drawdown) the loop's shore-side pads run ~35.47472,-86.22832 to 35.47370,-86.22697 on open grass with scattered trees; 3DEP gives the pads 267.8-268.9 m and the grass edge 265.6-267.5 m against a ~266.7 m summer pool - pads ~1-2 m above the summer waterline ~15-25 m away over a gentle (~6%) slope. Kayak test passes.
OPERATOR: Google's camprrm.com link redirects to gocamptennessee.com (Vista/RRM = Go Camp Tennessee); stored website and phone current.

SEASON: operator 'Season Opens Friday, March 15th / Season Closed: Friday, November 15th' agrees with the stored 03-15..11-14 (Campspot's closure starts 11-15, so the last night is the 14th) - left as stored.

SITE SHARE: Campspot lists 23 hookup RV sites of the 45 the operator counts; the rest are drawn unlisted on its map. The operator page does not mention long-term camping here (Barton Springs' page does). Likely nightly-dominant on the evidence; noted for completeness.
FEES left as stored ($40-47 site rate + $10 surcharge, 2026-10-13); April 2027 Campspot list averages $50/$53 are consistent once the $10 surcharge and Campspot's 3% are taken out.
